audit.why: 22.73% over 22 games is the worst matchup in the slice by a distance, and the chart (Skill / Olaf / Olaf / Skill / Skill / Olaf / Olaf) plus difficulty 7.5/10 already reflects a losing lane. The problem was never the verdict, it was that two of the three reasons given for it were mechanically wrong.
audit.corrected: No side or rating changed; the reasoning underneath was rebuilt.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] calls Hero's Entrance 'a global swing' and no spike carries a cooldown.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 onto an ALLY within 4000/4750/5500. Ragnarok is 100/90/80, Undertow a flat 9s, Reckless Swing 11/10/9/8/7, Tough It Out 16/15/14/13/12.
audit.corrected: Global claim removed; Ragnarok's 100s, Undertow's 9s and Reckless Swing's 11s written into the spikes, breakdown.cooldowns and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six strings call Olaf's lifesteal 'Vicious Strikes' and attribute it to his W, including the instruction 'never start a trade he can heal back through with W'.
audit.why: Vicious Strikes is not in Olaf's kit. His W is Tough It Out — attack speed and a SHIELD, 16s at rank 1, no healing at all. The lifesteal is Berserker Rage, his PASSIVE, and Riot scales it off MISSING health. That inverts the advice: chunking Olaf halfway does not weaken him, it arms him.
audit.corrected: Renamed and re-slotted throughout, with the missing-health scaling made the reason not to half-commit. Written into early, spikes[0], whys[0], whys[1], wants.foe[1], tldr and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings say Ragnarok deals or grants true damage, and two credit it with move speed: 'Ragnarok true damage and the move speed it grants', 'turns his autos into true damage'.
audit.why: Riot on Ragnarok: 'passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.' No true damage and no move speed anywhere in it. The true damage belongs to Reckless Swing (E) — 325 range, 11s at rank 1, true damage to the target and to himself.
audit.corrected: True damage reassigned to Reckless Swing; Ragnarok restated as disable immunity that holds only while he keeps attacking, plus passive armour and MR.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'he slows you on every axe pickup' garbles what the pickup does.
audit.why: Riot: 'If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is RESET.' The slow comes from the axe hitting you; the pickup refunds the whole 9 seconds. The counterplay is to fight away from where the axe landed.

report[8] already carries Oblivion Orb early, which is right and now has a stated reason: Berserker Rage's lifesteal grows as his health falls, so Grievous Wounds matters most in exactly the window where the old text told you to keep swinging.
audit.corrected: Left as-is; the justification now appears in early and loading.

edits.before: Olaf owns the opening: at level 1-2 he has Vicious Strikes lifesteal and Undertow axes that slow you on hit, while you have one ability and no engage, so he just walks up, slows you on every axe pickup, and out-trades your weak early stats. Don't contest CS in melee — last-hit with the hard-hitting center column of Winds of War from max range and accept you're behind. Your only real early window is level 3: once Shield of Durand and Justice Punch exist you can punish a whiffed Undertow by W-channeling into the taunt, E-knocking him up, and grabbing a few last-hits — but never start a trade he can heal back through with W.
edits.after: Olaf owns the opening: at level 1-2 his passive Berserker Rage gives attack speed and lifesteal that GROW as his health drops, and Undertow slows from 1000 range, while you have one ability and no engage. Chunking him halfway does not weaken him, it arms him. Don't contest CS in melee — last-hit with the hard-hitting center column of Winds of War from max range and accept you're behind. Your one early window is level 3: punish a whiffed Undertow by W-channeling into the taunt and E-knocking him up, then take a few last-hits. His W is Tough It Out, a 16-second shield, not a heal.

notes: Worst matchup in the slice at 22.73%, and the entry was wrong about two of the three things it blamed. First, six strings call Olaf's lifesteal 'Vicious Strikes' and put it on his W — Vicious Strikes is not in the kit at all, his W is Tough It Out (attack speed plus a SHIELD, no healing), and the lifesteal is the passive Berserker Rage, which Riot scales off MISSING health. The practical damage is severe: the page says 'never start a trade he can heal back through with W', which points the player at the wrong ability and hides the actual rule, that Olaf gets stronger the lower he falls, so a half-commit is the worst possible trade. Second, five strings attribute true damage (and move speed) to Ragnarok. Ragnarok is passive armour and magic resist plus immunity to disables while he keeps attacking; the true damage is Reckless Swing (E), 325 range, 11s at rank 1. FLAG MISFIRE, deliberately not written: _missing-interactions claims Undertow denies Justice Punch via grounding, but Riot's text for Undertow is damage plus armour and move-speed reduction only — no grounding — so I made no dash-denial claim.
